usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.io/api/generate/gpt-image-2/edit with JSON body {prompt, images[], size?, quality?} (x402 pay, ~$0.01 at quality:low). Returns {jobId, status:"pending"}. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIWX auth (free, same wallet that paid) until status==="complete".

inputExample.prompt: add a small red circle in the top-left corner

usage.outputShape: POST returns body.jobId (+ body.status="pending", body.type="gpt-image-2-edit"); no image in POST. Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} returns body.status, body.progress, and on completion body.result.imageUrl (the edited PNG on public.blob.vercel-storage.com).
quirks: Registry priceDisplay/paymentAccepts say $10.00 (10000000 USDC), but pricing is DYNAMIC (0-10 USD) and the LIVE x402 quote at quality:low was only $0.01 — do NOT skip as over-cap.
EDIT endpoint REQUIRES an input image: body must include images[] (array of image URLs, minItems 1) plus prompt. Both are required.

Image URL must be a DIRECT full image URL. A Wikipedia /thumb/.../280px-...png resized-variant URL was rejected with 400 {success:false, error:'Invalid image URL(s)'} (nothing paid); the direct original .../commons/4/47/file.png worked.
ASYNC: POST only pays + enqueues, returning {success, jobId, status:'pending', type}. No image in POST response.

Poll endpoint is GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (note host is stablestudio.DEV not stablestudio.io, and path is /api/jobs/, NOT /api/status/). This URL is not in the registry; derive it from the jobId.

Poll requires SIWX auth as the SAME wallet that PAID for the job. A different wallet identity (e.g. agentcash fetch's own wallet) gets 403 Unauthorized {success:false,error:'Unauthorized'}. The polling is free once authenticated.
Job went pending->complete in ~35s (loading 10%->70%->100%); a few polls every ~8s suffices.
Result image is a live public PNG on *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com (verified 200 image/png ~680KB).
usage.guide: Edit an image: POST to https://stablestudio.io/api/generate/gpt-image-2/edit with JSON {"prompt": "...", "images": ["<direct image URL>"], "size": "1024x1024", "quality": "low|medium|high"} and pay via x402 (live cost ~$0.01 at quality:low, despite the $10 registry surface). The images[] URL must be a direct full image (not a Wikipedia /thumb/ resized variant, which 400s). The response gives body.jobId. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} using SIWX auth with the SAME wallet that paid (free; a different wallet gets 403) every few seconds until body.status === "complete". Read the edited image from body.result.imageUrl, a public PNG URL.
